owner_review: Provisional research universe approved for VWRP, CUKX, IGLT, AGBP, SGLN and XSTR. Still not frozen. CSP1 and ERNS are optional comparisons only. This file is not an operational allowlist and it does not authorise execution.
fscs_general_information: General information, not advice. Verify before reliance. FSCS does not protect against investment or market losses. These overseas-domiciled (Irish or Luxembourg) funds and the ETC issuer are generally outside FSCS for fund or issuer failure. FSCS may cover failure of a UK-authorised platform or broker in certain circumstances (for example up to £85,000 per person per firm). Eligibility depends on the firm and the claim. See https://www.fscs.org.uk/.
fee_treatment: Exchange prices and NAVs of these listed products are already net of the fund or issuer charge. The simulator does not deduct OCF, TER, or the XSTR all-in fee again. Schedules below are disclosure, and a gross index proxy would have to opt in before any drag is applied. VWRP is time-varying: 0.22% until the announced reduction, 0.19% from 7 Oct 2025, 0.14% from 28 Jul 2026. The start date of the 0.22% rate is UNVERIFIED.
price_units: Divide GBp and GBX quotes by 100 to get pounds. GBP quotes are already in pounds. Do not FX-convert a sterling line a second time.
